text: The room layout made sense: bags fitted by the wardrobe, chargers reached the bedside, and there was space to move around. Housekeeping came while we were out and replaced towels. We found the breakfast selection ordinary, but it was ready early and saved time.

We stayed one night before a morning appointment. Check-in was easy and the room was clean, though the mattress felt quite firm. I slept reasonably well; my partner did not. The desk explained the early checkout process clearly, and we were on our way without delay.

We had an early departure and asked about breakfast timing the night before. The desk gave a clear answer, and food was ready when we arrived. Our room had been quiet all night, so we were rested for the journey. A reliable one-night stop.
Wi-Fi was steady for my work emails.
Very slow check-in. We were tired before getting upstairs.

My booking question about parking was answered clearly before arrival. Spaces were available when we reached the hotel, and directions from the entrance were easy to follow. The room was bright and comfortable. The bathroom mirror lighting could be better, but everything else worked well.

My family arrived around the usual check-in time but the room was not ready. We waited in the lobby for close to an hour without an estimate we could rely on. Once inside, the bathroom bin had not been emptied. Staff corrected that quickly; the combined delays were still too much.

At evening check-in the queue moved slowly, then the key we received did not open the door. After two trips back downstairs, a staff member brought another card. The room itself was small but usable; losing almost an hour to a basic access problem set the tone for our short stay.

The bath towels were fresh, but smaller than I prefer. My partner liked the cooler room temperature while I needed the extra blanket. Staff sent one up quickly. Outside noise was faint with the window shut. Nothing remarkable, just a few comforts that depended on personal taste.

We arrived just before the evening rush and checked in quickly. Later, a housekeeping request for more water was delivered without fuss. The room had a comfortable chair as well as a bed, useful during our two-night visit. Breakfast coffee could have been hotter.
Bilik agak panas walaupun penghawa dingin dipasang.

We came for a concert and returned quite late. The desk was still helpful when our card needed resetting. The room was tidy and the mattress comfortable after a long day. Street noise was audible in the morning, but it did not interrupt our sleep.
Good value overall, though breakfast was basic.
Breakfast was hot and ready on time.

The shower door did not seal well, so water spread onto the bathroom floor. I used a spare towel to dry it and told reception. They sent more towels, but no repair happened during my two-night visit. Everything else was ordinary rather than memorable.
A disappointing one-night stop.
Clean enough. Desk space was limited.

It was my second stay and the consistency impressed me. The room was clean again, the air-conditioning did not rattle, and housekeeping replaced what I used without disturbing my things. I also appreciated a clear explanation of the deposit at arrival and a prompt checkout.
Breakfast was simple and ready early.

I asked at reception for a quieter place to work for an hour, and they pointed me toward an available lounge area. Back in the room, the desk was fine for shorter tasks. The bed was comfortable and the bathroom spotless. A useful stay for mixed work and leisure.

We paid extra for breakfast and came down with plenty of time before it ended. Several trays were empty, the eggs were cold, and there were no clean cups nearby. Staff refilled some items after we asked, but we had already needed to leave. It felt poor value for a family of four.

I asked about the deposit before arrival and thought I understood the amount. At check-in the total held was higher because of an additional charge that was not explained clearly. The staff sorted out my questions, but it took a while. The room itself was tidy and quiet.
A useful base for a busy weekend.
More hooks in the bathroom would help.

Two friends and I used the hotel as a base for a weekend. Our room was clean, and the bathroom had enough hooks for towels. Breakfast near closing time was still being replenished. We heard a little road noise, but it was not a problem for us.
The queue at checkout was ridiculous.
Staff fixed the key card quickly.

I liked the lobby seating, but the room did not have a convenient socket near the desk. Working with a laptop meant stretching a cable across the floor. Wi-Fi was adequate for email and slow for meetings. The stay was affordable; the workspace was not very practical.
Smooth from arrival to departure.
房间安静，服务也很好。
Not awful, just not very comfortable.
Selesa dan bersih. Memang puas hati.

We visited during a busy weekend and expected some waiting. Check-in was organized, and staff gave a realistic estimate when our room was being finished. The room was clean, the children slept well, and breakfast offered enough simple choices. It was an easy family stay.
Very convenient and fairly priced.

A late arrival should have been straightforward. Instead, the desk could not find our reservation at first and asked us to wait off to the side while they checked. We eventually got a room, but no clear explanation for the delay. After a long journey, it was a rough welcome.

The hot water changed from warm to cold several times during each shower. Maintenance looked at it after my first report and said it should be better, but the same thing happened the next morning. The bathroom was clean enough; having to rush every shower spoiled the stay.
Everything worked. Lovely stay.

We stored luggage after checkout, and the handoff was straightforward. Earlier, though, our room had not been serviced when we returned around 4 pm. Clean towels arrived after a call, but the bin was left full. It was a short stay, so the missed service stood out.

Our family arrived before the room was ready, so staff stored our bags and suggested a place nearby to wait. They called when we could check in. The room was clean, with enough space for a child's luggage. Morning breakfast got crowded, but we found food easily.

Traffic noise reached our room after midnight, even with the window closed. The bed was comfortable and the room looked fresh, so I wanted to like it more. Earplugs helped on the second night. Anyone who sleeps lightly may want to ask about a quieter spot if one is available.
Had to request towels twice.

I checked the final bill before leaving and found a second breakfast charge even though breakfast had already been included in the amount paid. It took two desk visits and a long wait to correct. The room was acceptable, but the payment confusion made an early checkout stressful.

A quiet room mattered more to me than a view, and this one delivered after the corridor settled. The window faced an unremarkable wall and daylight was limited. Shower temperature was steady, and the price was reasonable. I would call it functional rather than somewhere to spend much time.

The pool was clean when we used it in the morning, and towels were available without asking around. Our room had plenty of daylight and a comfortable bed. Staff gave us a useful tip on the best time to avoid the breakfast crowd. The whole stay felt easy.

The room smelled faintly stale when we first entered, and opening the window for a while improved it. Bedding was clean and the shower worked fine. It was manageable for one night, but the odor returned when the air-conditioning was off. I would choose a different place for a longer visit.
Kids liked the pool. I liked the quiet room.
The bed was firm and suited me.

A weekend away with friends can get hectic, but this stay was simple. Check-in was organized, our rooms were ready together, and everyone found the beds comfortable. We used luggage storage after checkout and collected the bags quickly. The location was convenient for our plans.
The bathroom floor stayed wet after every shower.
Room was tiny for the price.

Our towels were replaced on the first day, but housekeeping missed the room entirely the following day. We called in the afternoon and were promised a visit. By evening nobody had come, so we collected towels ourselves. For a multi-night stay, that level of follow-through was disappointing.

Breakfast was advertised as starting early enough for us, yet at opening several items and utensils were still being set out. We waited until we had to leave and took only toast. No one was rude; the service simply was not ready when it said it would be.

My partner cares about sleep more than hotel extras, so the quiet room mattered. We heard little traffic, the air-conditioning stayed steady, and both of us liked the pillows. Breakfast was fresh when we went down early. A relaxed weekend from start to finish.

After a delayed journey, it was a relief to find check-in quick and clear. The room was fresh, the bed comfortable, and the curtains shut out the morning light. I slept late, then had a hot shower with steady pressure. It was exactly the easy stop I needed.

I asked for a quieter room because I had an early meeting. The first room faced a busy street, and the alternative offered was cooler but close to the lift. I stayed with the first. Staff tried, though neither choice really addressed what I needed.

Our room was ready on arrival and check-in was pleasant. Later we noticed one window latch felt loose and the curtains caught on it. Maintenance came the next afternoon and adjusted it. The issue was not major, but waiting in the room for the visit interrupted our plans.

I expected a plain overnight room and got a little more comfort than that. The sheets felt fresh, there was a proper reading light, and the air-conditioning was quiet. Staff answered a question about transport without making us wait. Storage for two suitcases was tight.

My sister and I stayed for a weekend. She valued the transport access; I liked how easy it was to find food nearby. We could hear some street activity after dark, and the pillows were too soft for me. Staff helped with luggage storage, so the trip still went smoothly.

The first thing I noticed was how quiet the room felt despite activity outside. Windows closed firmly, the air-conditioning cooled steadily, and the mattress suited me. Breakfast had enough fresh options without feeling crowded. For a three-night stay, those basics made a real difference.
Parking was full and the directions were confusing.
Nothing special, nothing terrible.

The room was compact, which I expected, but the lack of upkeep was harder to accept: dust on the shelves, marks on the mirror, and a bathroom tap that dripped constantly. I told the front desk. They noted it, but nothing changed before checkout the next day.
Easy luggage storage after checkout.

My friend and I chose this hotel for the price and transport access. Both worked out well. We could walk to dinner, return to a quiet room, and leave early the next day. The shower warmed quickly, and the towels were fresh. Very good value for us.

My early departure was easy because the desk had explained the process the night before. The room stayed quiet until morning and the shower heated up quickly. I would have liked another socket near the bed, but that was a minor issue in an otherwise smooth stay.
Uncomfortable bed. Not for me.
房间还可以，枕头对我来说太软。

The gym was small but had enough for a short workout before breakfast. My room had a steady connection for email and a comfortable mattress. Check-in took longer than expected when several guests arrived together, yet staff kept the line informed. Good stay overall.

We used the pool for a short swim in the afternoon and found it pleasant, though seating nearby was limited. Our room was tidy, with steady hot water. At checkout, a small billing question took a few minutes to resolve. This was an okay family weekend overall.

During a rainy afternoon we spent more time in the room than planned. It was comfortable enough to read, work, and rest without feeling cramped. The air-conditioning was quiet, the lights were well placed, and room service answered a small request promptly. A pleasant surprise.

I used the gym before work and found it tidy, with no wait for the equipment I wanted. Back in the room, the shower pressure was strong and there was enough counter space to get ready. The Wi-Fi stayed steady all evening. A very practical hotel for my trip.
The Wi-Fi kept disconnecting all evening.

At breakfast there were enough choices, yet the bread was dry and the coffee machine had a queue. I spent most of the day out, so those mornings were my main impression of the hotel. The room was clean, but the pillows were too soft for me.

I needed one quiet night before an early train. Traffic was audible even with the window closed, and a compressor-like sound kept starting beside the bed. Reception offered a different room, but it was nearly midnight and moving everything seemed worse. I barely slept and checked out exhausted.
Would stay again for the same price.

We arrived with two sleepy children and got through check-in fast. Staff pointed us to the lift and confirmed breakfast hours before we went upstairs. The room was ready, clean, and quiet. The children slept immediately, which made the rest of our weekend much easier.
Okay for a short stopover.

I chose this hotel mainly for parking. On arrival, the available spaces were full and the suggested overflow option was a longer walk than expected with luggage. No one could say when a space might open. The room was ordinary, but this practical problem made the price hard to justify.
Bright room, curtains worked well.

There was a strong damp smell when I opened the room door. I asked for another room, but the replacement also smelled musty, though less strongly. The staff tried to help and brought an air freshener. That masked it briefly; the smell returned overnight, and I did not feel comfortable staying another day.

The bathroom was clean, but the shower pressure was weak and the water turned lukewarm halfway through. I mentioned it after the first morning. Staff offered to send someone, although I was heading out and could not wait. It happened again the next day, so the stay felt below par.

The bed linen had a visible stain near the pillow when we pulled back the cover. A staff member delivered fresh linen after we called, yet we had to change it ourselves because nobody returned. It was late and we were tired. I expected the room to be ready to sleep in.
Nice shower and comfortable pillows.
Would gladly book again.
Shower pressure was weaker than expected.
Breakfast felt picked over, even though we arrived early.
Air con noisy lah, barely slept.
Senang cari makan, bilik pun selesa.
Good location, noisy nights.
Fresh towels and a spotless room.
Still waiting for an answer about the extra bill item.
Strong Wi-Fi and a useful desk.

I brought my father for an overnight appointment nearby. The lift route was easy for him, staff gave straightforward directions, and our room had space to move around. The bathroom was clean with reliable hot water. Checkout was quick, which helped us leave on schedule.

We arrived with two children and appreciated the quick check-in. The room layout made it easy to keep our bags out of the walkway. Breakfast was busy, though, and we waited for clean plates. The food was decent once restocked. It suited a short family stop.
Loved the comfortable bed.
Friendly welcome despite the queue.
Average room, excellent shower.
No clean towels when we checked in.
Breakfast okay, coffee lukewarm.
Reasonable price for an ordinary stay.

Our weekend plans kept us outside most of the day, so we wanted a clean place to return to. The room delivered that, with soft lighting and a shower that stayed warm. Staff stored our bags after checkout, letting us enjoy the afternoon without carrying them.

I booked for a solo weekend and enjoyed the helpful directions at reception. The room was brighter than expected, with curtains that closed well at night. The bathroom had a slow drain, although it never overflowed. I mentioned it at checkout and was told it would be checked.

The room looked fine when we arrived late, but the bathroom floor had hair near the drain and the sink still had toothpaste marks. I called the desk, and someone came to wipe it down after about forty minutes. By then we were ready for bed, so the first night felt unnecessarily tiring.

The listing made the room seem suitable for working, yet the only desk surface was crowded by the kettle and television. Wi-Fi dropped repeatedly during a video call, and the socket beside the bed was loose. Staff suggested the lobby, where it was noisy. I had to work elsewhere the next day.

The television remote did not work reliably, and the bedside lamp flickered. Reception sent someone to change batteries and check the lamp the next afternoon. Both were minor problems individually, but the room felt less cared for than its price suggested. Sleep quality was okay.

A simple stay in the best sense. I checked in late, found the room cool and quiet, and slept well on a firm mattress. In the morning breakfast was ready when it opened. No surprises on the bill, no repeated calls to the desk, just everything working.

My work call held on the room Wi-Fi in the morning, then started dropping later that night. The small desk was just big enough for a laptop, and the chair was comfortable for an hour or two. Staff offered another connection, which improved things somewhat. Mixed experience overall.

The hotel worked as a base for visiting friends. Walking to food and transport was straightforward, and staff held our luggage after checkout. Our room was clean but quite narrow around the bed. If you plan to spend the day out, it is easier to overlook that.

The air-conditioning took a while to cool the room after we returned in the afternoon. Once it did, the temperature stayed comfortable overnight. I liked the blackout curtains and the quiet corridor. The bathroom shelf was small, which was only mildly inconvenient for a weekend stay.

My parents found the walk from the lift to our room longer than expected. Staff helped with one bag on arrival, which was kind, but the route remained tiring for them. The room was well kept. This stay was simply a poor fit for our needs.

Breakfast near opening was calm, with hot food and clean tables ready. I had a short business stay and needed to be out promptly, so that mattered. The room Wi-Fi handled email, the desk was comfortable, and checkout took only a few minutes.

Breakfast started early enough for our plans, and toast, fruit, and hot drinks were ready when we arrived. The cooked items were less fresh. We spent most of our time outside, so the compact room was adequate. Check-in took longer than expected at the evening rush.

We stayed three nights while visiting relatives. Each time we returned, the room had been serviced and fresh towels were in place. The children liked the pool, and staff helped us find a quieter time to use it. The final bill matched what we had been told.
The location helped; the noise did not.

There was an evening check-in queue, but staff kept it moving and explained the wait. Once upstairs, the room was spotless and smelled fresh. We asked for an extra blanket, which arrived promptly. The service felt calm even though the hotel seemed busy.

I needed to finish a report after dinner and the room had a desk with enough space for my laptop and notes. Wi-Fi stayed stable throughout. Check-in had a short queue, but staff explained the deposit clearly. The bed was firm, which suited me well.

For a two-night work trip, the room was too noisy to use after dinner. A nearby event or gathering carried through the wall until late, and the desk could only offer earplugs. The internet also slowed badly at night. I would not choose this stay again when I need rest and reliable calls.

We arrived after dinner and stood in a slow check-in line with just one person at the counter. Once it was our turn, the process was quick. The room had enough space, though the air-conditioning took a long time to cool it. Fine for a stopover, less comfortable for lingering.

The curtains did not close fully, leaving light across the bed from outside all night. I tried to pin the gap with a towel, but it slipped. Reception said they would note it for maintenance, with no alternative offered during my stay. Sleep was poor ahead of an early appointment.

A compact room, yes, but everything we used was clean and working. We spent two days out exploring and appreciated coming back to a quiet bed and a shower with steady pressure. The location made transport simple. Breakfast was modest, so we ate elsewhere on the second morning.

The room had enough storage for a short stay and a useful reading lamp. I noticed dust on a high shelf, but the main surfaces and bathroom were clean. Breakfast was basic and replenished promptly. I would probably stay again if the price were similar.
Our room was ready, but parking took a while.

The corridor was quiet overnight, but every morning I could hear doors and housekeeping carts quite early. My curtains also let in a strip of light. I stayed for three nights and got used to it, yet I would not call the room restful if sleeping in matters.

We arrived with an older relative and requested a room with as little walking as possible. The assigned room was far down a corridor, and the lifts were slow each time we went out. Staff said they were full and could not move us. It turned a simple overnight stop into a frustrating one.

My early checkout took longer than planned because there was confusion over a small charge on the bill. It was removed after staff checked the record. They stayed polite, but I missed the easy departure I had counted on. The room had been quiet and comfortable enough.
地方方便，房间干净，整体不错。

I liked the firm mattress, but my friend found it uncomfortable. We both thought the bathroom lighting was dim for getting ready. Hot water and towels were fine, and the room was quiet. Breakfast had a reasonable spread, though it became crowded once a group arrived.
The room was quiet after 10 pm.
Firm bed, which some people may like.
Not coming back. Too many small problems.

Parking was available when we arrived in the afternoon, though entering from the road took a careful turn. The front desk gave clear instructions for exit. Our room was ordinary, clean, and slightly warm until the air-conditioning caught up. Price seemed about right for what we got.

The bed was comfortable and the room smelled fresh, but there were not enough accessible sockets for two people charging devices. We took turns using the one by the desk. Reception lent an adapter when asked. Fine for a weekend, with a small inconvenience that kept repeating.
Wi-Fi struggled whenever I tried to call home.
Slept well but breakfast was bland.
Great for a short work trip.

The breakfast area became crowded soon after 8 am and it was hard to find a place to sit. Food was replenished eventually, but the hot dishes were only warm. The location made it easy to get around, and staff were pleasant. I would skip breakfast next time.
Check-in was quick, even with our late arrival.

My dad needed a place to sit while we waited for a room, and staff found a chair promptly. The room became available later than expected. Once inside, it was comfortable enough, with a good shower and stable temperature. The waiting made the first day feel shorter.
We slept so well.
Room was dusty and the bathroom smelled stale.
The pillows were too flat for me.
Wi-Fi worked better in the morning.
Friendly desk, slow housekeeping.

The location worked for us because shops and transport were within a manageable walk. That convenience came with traffic sound in the evening. Curtains blocked most light, and the shower had good pressure. I would return for a busy sightseeing trip, probably not for a quiet retreat.

The staff member at reception explained transport options clearly without pushing any particular choice. That small help saved us time on a first visit. Our room had good daylight, enough charging points, and a comfortable bed. We liked the straightforward breakfast too.

We asked for an extra pillow after unpacking and received it before bedtime. The room was quiet until early morning, when doors along the corridor started closing. The shower had good pressure but little space for toiletries. It did the job for a one-night stop.
还算干净，不过电梯等得久。

I came mainly for a reasonable price near where I had meetings. The desk and Wi-Fi were sufficient for email, less so for long video calls. The room was clean and the bed fine. An evening check-in queue was the biggest hassle; otherwise it met basic expectations.

There was a brief power interruption in our room's charging socket, but the other outlets worked. Maintenance checked it the following morning. We stayed two nights and liked the quiet after dark. The breakfast coffee was weak, although the staff kept the food area tidy.
Could not sleep with the corridor noise.

My partner and I liked the quiet room and the fact that shops were an easy walk away. We did not eat breakfast at the hotel, so cannot judge it. Check-out was efficient and luggage storage was simple. For the rate we paid, the stay felt worthwhile.

We had a late arrival and the desk was staffed, which was a relief. The first key needed resetting, but that took only a few minutes. The bed was okay and the room quiet. By morning, the air-conditioning felt too cold even on a higher setting, so comfort was uneven.
The deposit explanation was unclear at first.

For a three-night stay, the first two housekeeping visits were fine. On the last afternoon, towels had not been replaced when we returned. A call brought them up promptly. The room was otherwise tidy, but the air conditioner made a soft rattle at night that took getting used to.

Stayed for one night with an early train the next day. The hotel arranged an uncomplicated checkout and held a bag briefly after we returned. Our room was quiet with a firm bed and clean bathroom. We did not spend enough time there to judge the facilities.
Good sleep and a clean bathroom.
The lamp flickered and nobody checked it before we left.
Easy checkout, clear bill, happy guest.

We checked in during a busy period and waited around twenty minutes. The person at the desk explained the deposit and gave clear directions upstairs. Our room was neat, yet the corridor smelled of cleaning product for part of the evening. It faded by bedtime. An average stay.

Not a large room, but thoughtfully arranged. My suitcase fitted away from the walkway, the bedside socket was easy to reach, and the curtains blocked outside light. After a long sightseeing day, the shower was hot and the bed felt excellent. I would happily return.

On my second visit, check-in was quicker than I remembered and the staff recognized the request for a quiet room from my booking. No grand view, but I slept well both nights. Towels were replaced as needed, and the final bill was easy to understand.
Clean bed, but the room felt damp.
Quiet night and a great shower.
Staff were nice. Waiting was not.

We booked for three nights and left after one. The first room had a persistent odor, while the second had an air conditioner that rattled loudly. Staff did try a room change, but neither option worked for us. It was disappointing because the common areas looked pleasant.
I expected more for a weekend rate.

I stayed with my mother and appreciated the lift access and clear signs from the entrance. The room was not far from the lift, which helped her. Shower controls were simple and the floor stayed mostly dry. Breakfast choices were basic, though service was attentive.
Towels arrived quickly when we asked.
Fine for one night, no longer.
Compact room, smart layout.
A peaceful break after a long journey.

A warm welcome after a long journey, with clear instructions about breakfast and the deposit. Our room had good daylight and curtains that blocked it at night. The shower pressure was strong. The only drawback was a slow lift at the morning rush.
Boleh tahan, cuma sarapan agak sesak.

We asked for extra towels after taking the children to the pool. They arrived within a sensible time, and the staff member checked whether we needed anything else. The room was clean and the beds comfortable. The pool area got busy later, so going earlier worked better.
The pool was a nice bonus.

The mattress was firmer than I like, and the pillows were quite flat. I asked for an extra pillow and it arrived late that evening, which helped a little. The room was clean and the staff courteous, but I did not sleep well over either of my two nights.

Our family room had enough beds, but there was little space left for bags and no easy place to dry damp towels. The kids liked being together, while the adults found the layout awkward. Breakfast options were limited near closing time. Friendly service could not quite make up for the practical annoyances.

I had several video calls during this work trip and the Wi-Fi held up in the room each time. The desk was wide enough for my laptop, notebook, and a drink. At night the corridor was quiet, and the mattress was supportive. I would book again for work.

My mum asked for a room that would be easy to reach from the lift. Staff confirmed the arrangement when we arrived and showed us the route. She found the bed comfortable, and the bathroom was simple to use. We both appreciated how smoothly the request was handled.

The lift wait at busy times was longer than I expected. Once upstairs, our room was tidy and reasonably quiet, but bringing luggage down for checkout took several rounds. Staff gave us directions to a nearby transport connection. Convenient location, awkward building flow.
Quick checkout, slow check-in.
The staff made our family stay easy.

Booked a weekend break and expected a quiet evening. Music from somewhere below was audible until late, though I cannot say where it came from. Staff apologised and offered another room, but we were already unpacked. The breakfast staff were friendly; I still left tired.
The shower never got properly warm.
Would consider returning if the rate is similar.

The hotel suited a short work trip: I could walk to food, charge my laptop beside the desk, and get out early without a checkout queue. My room was small but well arranged. I heard some corridor chatter before 10 pm, then it settled down.
The pool was pleasant in the morning.

We were woken around 1 am by loud voices in the corridor, then again by doors closing. I mentioned it at reception and was told someone would check. The noise continued for much of the night. With a child trying to sleep, we got very little rest during our weekend stay.
Too expensive for a room that needed cleaning.
Quiet room, fair bill.

We requested two towels for two guests, but only one was in the bathroom. A replacement came after our second call, about an hour later. Small issue, yes, but it was late and we wanted to shower. The compact room was otherwise clean and the bed was decent.

I arrived late and had a question about a charge on the booking. The desk explained it clearly before I paid. Upstairs, the room was tidy and the bathroom had everything I needed. I slept without corridor noise and left feeling the price was fair.

Our bathroom drain was slow from the first shower. By the second morning, water covered much of the floor and stayed there for ages. Housekeeping sent extra towels, but no one addressed the drain during our three-night stay. The rest of the room was tidy; the bathroom made it difficult to use.

I used the Wi-Fi mostly for work messages and it was unreliable in the room, especially in the evening. The desk suggested reconnecting and offered a different network, but that did not solve it. Calls worked from the lobby. For leisure this might be tolerable; for work it was inconvenient.
窗帘关不严，晚上外面的灯一直照进来。

The air-conditioning ran all night without cooling the room properly. We reported it after dinner and were told someone would look, but nobody came before bedtime. The next morning the desk offered an apology. Two restless nights in a warm room made the otherwise convenient location irrelevant for us.

I chose the hotel for convenient transport and it served that purpose nicely. The walk outside was busy during the day, while my room stayed fairly quiet. Hot water was reliable and the Wi-Fi handled ordinary browsing. For a couple of nights, I was happy.
